name: intro
label: Intro
default: A structured, research-driven process from first conversation to launch.

default.title: Information Gathering
default.desc: We start by understanding your business, target audience, and goals. This lays the foundation for a website that meets your specific needs.

default.title: Planning
default.desc: Based on the gathered information, we create a strategic plan for your website: structure, technology stack, and project timelines.

default.title: Wireframing
default.desc: We develop wireframes to outline the basic layout and functionality of your site, aligning the look and feel before design begins.

default.title: Content Writing
default.desc: Compelling, SEO-friendly content that resonates with your audience and supports your brand voice.

default.title: Design & Build
default.desc: Visually stunning, conversion-focused design and development, refined with your feedback at every step.

default.title: Test, Review & Launch
default.desc: Thorough testing across devices and browsers, final review, and a smooth launch with monitoring.
